_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Neutral F&G and contained momentum keep the tape in a coil one rung up at most; no single breaker (dead ETF impulse, crowded longs vs Fed/CVD offset) forces a move.
next_move.brains_agree: No clean agreement — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative only reports intake rise with no forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55 and 30d momentum stays contained without an ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with F&G above 55, or crowded longs unwind with F&G under 40 and momentum breaking down
